facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident during routine operation on P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-3222 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during routine operation while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 9 April 2016 a potential incident was recorded on P-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
